course.name: 6.0001 Introduction to Computer Science and Programming in Python

gradingScheme.notes: Before the final quiz, students may drop up to 2 problem sets. If dropped, the percent that the problem sets are worth will be rolled into the final quiz score.

deadlines.title: Midterm Quiz
deadlines.sourceText: 2 closed-book quizzes (notes permitted: 1 page for the midterm quiz, 2 pages for the final quiz)

deadlines.title: Final Quiz
deadlines.sourceText: 2 closed-book quizzes (notes permitted: 1 page for the midterm quiz, 2 pages for the final quiz)

deadlines.title: Problem sets
deadlines.sourceText: Each problem set will involve programming in Python. There will be 6 problem sets in the course.

deadlines.title: Problem Set 1
deadlines.sourceText: Starting with Problem Set 1, additional late days can be accumulated for each assignment, one late day for each day the assignment is turned in ahead of the deadline.
